## Perplexity Product Portfolio [...] ## Conclusion

Perplexity AI sits at annualized revenue above $750 million, with a round that could value it at more than $30 billion still under discussion. That August 2026 snapshot marks a revenue run rate roughly tripled inside a year. The query base underneath scaled from 3,000 queries in a single day in 2022 to 30 million queries a day by mid-2025. Comet adds a retention flywheel, alongside paid publisher partnerships and an agentic-AI stack. [...] Nvidia is weighing an investment in a new round that could value the AI search startup above $30 billion, reported by The Information in August 2026.
   Bloomberg reported earlier in 2026 that Perplexity signed a $750 million Azure agreement with Microsoft, per TechStartups.

results.title: Perplexity AI - Wikipedia
results.content:
As of early 2026, Perplexity AI reached a valuation of $21.21 billion following its Series E-6 funding round. In January 2026, the company signed a three-year, $750 million agreement with Microsoft to use its Azure cloud and its Foundry service, giving Perplexity access to models from OpenAI, Anthropic and xAI. Amazon Web Services remained its main cloud provider. [...] In February 2026, Perplexity transitioned to a subscription-first model by discontinuing its AI-integrated advertising strategy. Leadership stated this move was intended to preserve user trust in the "answer engine," prioritizing objective results over ad revenue.

## Products and services

[edit]

| Perplexity AI | [...] [edit]

Perplexity has been contracted to produce a chatbot for Donald Trump's social media platform Truth Social.

### Perplexity Computer

[edit]

In February 2026, Perplexity launched Perplexity Computer, a general-purpose AI agent designed to autonomously perform multi-step tasks using multiple large language models and specialized subagents.

In April 2026, Perplexity introduced Personal Computer, an extension of Computer designed to operate on a user's local device.

Title: Changelog - Perplexity
Content: November 2026
Decisions APISearch
Decisions API: web grounding
Set mode to "web_grounding" on POST /v1/decisions to check your questions against the web. Before the model answers, the API runs a Fast Search for each question, up to 100 questions, and adds the results to the state as evidence. The response lists them in search_results. Requests without mode are unchanged.Each search costs $0.001, in addition to input tokens for the added results. The Perplexity Python library and the TypeScript SDK don’t have a mode parameter yet, so send it in the request body. See Web grounding and Pricing.

Title: Changelog - Perplexity
Content: November 2026
Agent APIEffort
Agent API: the ultra effort level
New: ultra (ultra@2026-11-05.0). The Agent API accepts effort="ultra" for broad research and data-gathering tasks where coverage matters most. Runs can take a long time, so you can also run it in background mode. ultra runs on anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 and has no frozen configuration; call it by name or pin the returned version. See Effort.
November 2026
Decisions API
Decisions API: URL fetching and page freshness
Pass a page URL as state with mode: "web_grounding" to fetch its text before searching. The fetched text replaces the URL before search. The response returns the page in fetched_results and search evidence in search_results.Set max_staleness to the maximum page age in seconds since its last crawl. An older stored copy triggers a fresh crawl. Each successful URL fetch costs $0.001 in addition to searches and input tokens.See Fetch a page from a URL for Python, TypeScript, and cURL examples.

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Perplexity AI

## Overview and Strategic Context
This pre-meeting briefing has been prepared for an executive discussion scheduled for November 20, 2026. The primary focus of this report is to evaluate Perplexity AI’s recent operational, product, and technical advancements over the trailing 30-day window leading up to November 15, 2026. Perplexity has aggressively expanded its footprint across autonomous agents, enterprise development tools, application programming interfaces (APIs), and financial research capabilities. 

---

## Recent Developments

### Product and Agent Infrastructure Enhancements
In November 2026, Perplexity introduced a robust set of updates aimed at autonomous agents and developer tooling. A major release brought "Teammates"—personal agents designed to own ongoing work and coordinate tasks across operations and marketing—alongside a fully local "Computer on Mac" feature, hands-free voice modes, and website editing capabilities ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/perplexity-ai)). 

Furthermore, the Agent API expanded its model ecosystem. It integrated support for advanced models such as `google/gemini-4-hydrogen`, `google/gemini-4-carbon`, and `anthropic/claude-fable-5-2`, while deprecating older iterations like the Gemini Flash 3.x series ([Perplexity, 2026](https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/resources/changelog)). To handle complex workloads, Perplexity added an `ultra` effort level (`ultra@2026-11-05.0`) running on `anthropic/claude-opus-5-5`, tailored for deep research and data-gathering tasks ([Perplexity, 2026](https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/resources/changelog)).

### Financial Tools and Data Integration
Perplexity significantly upgraded its Computer platform by integrating financial research tools for private companies. Powered by data sourced directly from Forge Global, users can access fundraising history, implied valuation, secondary pricing, public marks, and company profiles without needing an independent license ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/perplexity-ai)). Additionally, the Decisions API received a `web_grounding` mode on `POST /v1/decisions`, allowing up to 100 questions per request to be verified against live web search results for a minor cost of $0.001 per search ([Perplexity, 2026](https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/resources/changelog)).

### Developer Ecosystem and Pricing Adjustments
Developer integration received strong emphasis through official SDKs for Python and TypeScript, Model Context Protocol (MCP) server support with one-click installation for Cursor, VS Code, and Claude Desktop, and secure remote MCP options via OAuth ([Perplexity, 2026](https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/resources/changelog)). Concurrently, Perplexity adjusted token economics, implementing automatic output-token limits of up to 128,000 tokens per generation without requiring manual budget constraints ([Perplexity, 2026](https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/resources/changelog)).

### Summary of Recent Model & API Pricing Changes

| Model / Feature | Provider / API | Pricing / Cost Structure | Key Capabilities |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gemini 4 Hydrogen** | Agent API | $1.50/M input, $0.075/M cached input, $7.50/M output | Includes reasoning tokens ([Perplexity, 2026](https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/resources/changelog)) |
| **Gemini 4 Carbon** | Agent API | $2.00/M input, $0.10/M cached input, $10.00/M output | Introductory pricing through Nov 30, 2026 ([Perplexity, 2026](https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/resources/changelog)) |
| **Web Grounding Mode** | Decisions API | $0.001 per search + input tokens | Fast Search validation for up to 100 questions ([Perplexity, 2026](https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/resources/changelog)) |
| **URL Fetching & Freshness** | Decisions API | $0.001 per successful fetch | Retrieves page text and handles crawl staleness ([Perplexity, 2026](https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/resources/changelog)) |

---

## Talking Points

* **Autonomous Multi-Agent Collaboration:** Discuss how "Teammates" and project shared memory redefine workflows from simple search queries to persistent operational execution ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/perplexity-ai)).
* **Enterprise Financial Intelligence:** Highlight the competitive edge gained by embedding Forge Global private market data directly into the Computer environment ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/perplexity-ai)).
* **Ecosystem Lock-in via MCP and SDKs:** Address how one-click MCP configurations for Cursor and VS Code ([Perplexity, 2026](https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/resources/changelog)) cement Perplexity as an indispensable backend layer for AI-native development environments.
* **Cost-Performance Optimization:** Analyze the impact of automatic output-token limits and reduced pricing tiers across Agent API effort levels on gross margins and enterprise adoption velocity ([Perplexity, 2026](https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/resources/changelog)).

---

## Open Questions

1. What are the long-term data licensing implications and cost structures of incorporating Forge Global private company metrics natively into Perplexity Computer?
2. How does Perplexity plan to manage latency and compute overhead when running background tasks utilizing the new `ultra` effort level on Claude Opus 5.5?
3. What enterprise security and data privacy safeguards are enforced when users connect remote custom MCP servers through OAuth and custom connectors?
